enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Remain still under the blanket. Turn body to the other side. Pull the blanket up. Keep sleeping. Breathe steadily. Remain lying on the mattress.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, showering and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Push the blanket aside. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the light. Sit on the toilet. Stand up. Flush the toilet. Take off clothes. Step into the shower. Turn on the shower tap. Wet hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Pour shampoo into hand. Rub shampoo into hair. Rinse hair. Pick up the soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Wipe hair. Wipe body. Hang the towel. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Turn off the tap. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, toasting bread and eating breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water at the sink. Put the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch to boil. Open the refrigerator door. Take out bread and butter. Close the refrigerator door. Open the bread bag. Take out two slices of bread. Put the slices into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Open the cupboard. Take out a plate. Put the plate on the counter. Open the cupboard. Take out a mug. Put the mug on the counter. Take the kettle. Pour hot water into the mug. Put the kettle down. Open the cupboard. Take out a tea bag. Drop the tea bag into the mug. Wait for the toaster. Take the toasted bread out of the toaster. Put the bread on the plate. Pick up a knife. Spread butter on the bread. Put the knife down. Carry the plate and the mug to the table. Sit on the chair. Pick up the bread. Eat the bread. Pick up the mug. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the plate and the mug to the sink. Put them down in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed for the workday and checking the phone for shift messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bedroom. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt. Take out trousers. Take off the towel. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Close the wardrobe door. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Press the phone button to wake the screen. Unlock the phone. Open the messaging app. Scroll through shift messages. Read the messages. Press the phone button. Put the phone into the pocket.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home as a health care professional, conducting telehealth consultations on the computer and monitor because the transport strike prevents commuting
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Sit on the chair at the desk. Press the computer power button. Turn on the monitor. Pick up the phone. Connect the phone to the router via Wi-Fi. Open the telehealth application on the computer. Log in with username and password. Put on the headset. Adjust the webcam. Open the patient appointment list. Click the first patient entry. Start the video call. Speak to the patient: 'Good morning, how are you feeling today?' Listen to the patient. Type notes on the keyboard. Click the next patient entry. Start the next video call. Speak to the patient. Type notes on the keyboard. Click the next patient entry. Start the next video call. Speak to the patient. Adjust the monitor angle. Type notes on the keyboard. Repeat video calls with patients. Scroll through the patient list. Click the next entry. Speak to the patient. Type notes. End the call. Log out of one session. Open the next session.

enriched_activities.activity: Heating food in the microwave and eating lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the lunch container. Close the refrigerator door. Open the microwave door. Put the container into the microwave. Close the microwave door. Press the microwave buttons to set the time. Press the start button. Wait for the microwave. Press the stop button when it beeps. Open the microwave door. Take out the container. Close the microwave door. Carry the container to the table. Sit on the chair. Open the container lid. Pick up the fork. Eat the food. Put the fork down. Close the container lid. Stand up. Walk back to the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short break with light stretching and a glass of water
enriched_activities.desc: Stand in the living room. Raise both arms above the head. Lower the arms. Bend forward. Straighten up. Turn the head left. Turn the head right. Rotate the shoulders. Walk to the kitchen counter. Pick up a glass. Fill the glass with water from the tap. Turn off the tap. Pick up the glass. Drink the water. Put the glass down. Walk back to the living room. Sit on the chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work from home, updating patient records, writing care notes and taking telehealth follow-up calls
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at the desk. Press the keyboard keys. Open the patient record software. Click the patient file. Type the updated information into the fields. Scroll down the record. Save the record. Open a new note document. Type care notes on the keyboard. Save the note. Pick up the phone. Dial the patient number. Speak to the patient: 'Hello, this is a follow-up call.' Listen to the patient. Write notes on the paper. End the call. Put the phone down. Open the next patient file. Type the updated information. Scroll through the record. Save the file. Open a new note document. Type care notes. Pick up the phone. Dial the next patient number. Speak to the patient. Listen. Write notes. End the call. Put the phone down. Click the next patient entry. Type information. Save the record. Adjust the monitor. Continue typing. Close the record software. Press the computer power button to shut down.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading and running the washing machine for a load of laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Walk to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the light. Open the washing machine door. Pick up the laundry basket. Take out clothes. Put the clothes into the drum. Close the washing machine door. Open the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Press the washing machine power button. Press the program button to select the cycle. Press the start button. Listen to the machine start filling water. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing out of work clothes and resting on the bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bedroom. Take the phone out of the pocket. Put the phone on the nightstand. Unbutton the shirt. Take off the shirt. Take off the trousers. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a t-shirt. Put on the t-shirt. Take out sweatpants. Put on the sweatpants. Close the wardrobe door. Lie down on the bed. Put the arms behind the head. Close the eyes. Turn to the side. Remain lying down.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the bed. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables and meat. Close the refrigerator door. Put the food on the counter. Open the cupboard. Take out a pan. Put the pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Press the heat setting button. Open the refrigerator door. Take out oil. Pour oil into the pan. Close the oil bottle. Put the oil bottle down. Pick up a knife. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Cut the meat. Turn the vegetables into the pan with the spatula. Stir the food. Add salt. Stir the food. Press the induction cooker power button to turn off. Open the cupboard. Take out a plate. Spoon the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit on the chair. Pick up the fork. Eat the food. Put the fork down. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the plate from the table. Carry the plate to the sink. Scrape the leftovers into the bin. Rinse the plate under the tap. Turn off the tap. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Put the plate into the rack. Pick up the fork. Put the fork into the basket. Pick up the glass. Put the glass into the rack. Push the lower rack in. Open the cupboard. Take out dishwasher tablets. Put one tablet into the dispenser. Close the dispenser lid. Close the dishwasher door. Press the dishwasher power button. Press the program button. Press the start button. Wipe the table with a cloth. Put the cloth down. Turn on the range hood. Turn off the range hood.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Sit on the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Watch the TV screen. Press the volume button. Put the remote control on the sofa. Lean back on the sofa. Cross the legs. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone. Scroll the phone screen. Put the phone down. Pick up the remote control. Press the channel button. Watch the TV. Change the channel again. Put the remote control down. Lean back. Stretch the arms. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Pick up a glass. Fill the glass with water. Turn off the tap. Walk back to the living room. Sit on the sofa. Drink the water. Put the glass on the table. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button to turn off the TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the light. Open the washing machine door. Take out the wet clothes. Put the clothes into the dryer. Close the washing machine door. Close the dryer door. Press the dryer power button. Press the start button. Turn on the tap. Wet the face. Pick up the soap. Rub soap on the face. Rinse the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Hang the towel. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put the toothbrush down. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, reading on the phone with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bedroom. Turn on the desk lamp. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Unlock the phone. Open the reading app. Scroll the page. Read the text on the screen. Scroll the page again. Turn the phone screen down. Put the phone on the nightstand. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Pick up the phone again. Unlock the phone. Scroll the page. Read the text. Press the phone button to lock the screen. Put the phone on the nightstand. Reach to the desk lamp. Press the desk lamp switch to turn it off.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Pull the blanket up to the chin. Turn to the right side. Turn to the left side. Remain still. Breathe steadily. Keep sleeping.
